title: Column closing call to action
description: A soft grey panel inset from the page edges, open at the bottom so the footer can continue it: a heavy 52px navy line, a muted sentence, then three quiet link cards, each with a small dotted icon tile in blue, a bold title and a muted note. The panel fades up from 20% as it scrolls into view; cards brighten on hover.
notes: made to sit directly above column-footer (they share the inset grey panel); set closed to round its bottom when used alone
the fade is a CSS view timeline, off under reduced motion
